proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: lean.ref not_hecke_baer_star_generic_sketch refutes an unrelated sketch (a Baer-* claim for matrices over ZMod 2), not the generic-q Baer-* claim or its failure locus.

[full review 2026-11-21; Lean changed] The sibling Lean gained baerStarRing_matrix_rclike, a sorry-free proof that M_n(K) with the conjugate transpose is Baer-* for every RCLike field K. With Wedderburn this is the right ingredient for a semisimple complex algebra with a positive star. lean.ref still points at not_hecke_baer_star_generic_sketch, which refutes the former axiom 'M_d(R) is Baer-* for every field and every star' via M_2(F_2) with the transpose; it says nothing about H_n(q). The statement still asserts Baer-* for H_n(q) over any characteristic-0 field with the bar involution sigma_i to sigma_i^{-1}, q to q^{-1}. That involution moves q, so for a fixed generic q in R it is not an involution of H_n(q) over R. It is not a positive star either, and the ts caveat itself says the claim needs one. The 'fails exactly where H_n(q) is not semisimple' characterisation is stated, not proved. No Lean declaration states the Hecke claim.

trap-superlative.notes: SUBSTANTIVE FINDING flagged, not edited: the "Equivalently" sentence understates the boxed set. Boxed: NonBaer(H_n(q)) = {q : q^{2k} = 1 for some k in 2..n}. Restated as: "q is a primitive 2k-th root of unity for some 2 <= k <= n ... q in {zeta_4, zeta_6, zeta_8, ..., zeta_{2n}} (primitive forms only)". That list omits the ODD-order roots, which the boxed set contains. Counterexample: q = zeta_3 satisfies q^6 = 1, so k = 3 puts it in the boxed set, and directly [3]_{zeta_3} = (zeta_3^3 - zeta_3^{-3})/(zeta_3 - zeta_3^{-1}) = 0/(i sqrt 3) = 0, so H_3(zeta_3) is genuinely non-semisimple - yet zeta_3 is a primitive 3rd root, not a primitive 2k-th root of any order. Correct enumeration: primitive d-th roots with d even and 4 <= d <= 2n, TOGETHER WITH d odd and 3 <= d <= n. Proposed fix: replace the "Equivalently" sentence with that two-case statement; the boxed display itself is correct and should stand.
